steps.summary: Signed in at /web/login with login 'admin' / password 'admin' and submitted the form. Login succeeded and the app loaded — I landed on the Odoo Discuss app (URL http://127.0.0.1:8069/web#action=123&cids=1&menu_id=81, page title "Odoo - Discuss"), not the generic apps dashboard. Verified from the live DOM: the login form fields are gone and the Discuss UI is rendered (top menu "Discuss", threads/channels sidebar, and the "Congratulations, your inbox is empty" heading).

Created and saved a new quotation in Sales > Orders > Quotations: Customer set to 'fwod61-n2 Bench Customer' by actually selecting the option from the autocomplete dropdown (list closed, "Internal link" appeared), one order line added from the product catalogue, Quantity set to 3, then saved — the form went from "New" to saved record S00022 (URL .../model=sale.order&view_type=form&id=22, title "Odoo - S00022", statusbar "Quotation"). Note: the first product I picked (Customizable Desk) opened a product-configurator modal ("Configure your product") which blocked the save (the form stayed dirty at "New"); I cancelled that modal and re-added the line with a plain product, after which the save succeeded. Observed on the saved record: line "[FURN_7777] Office Chair", Qty 3.00, Unit Price £ 70.00, Taxes 20%, line Tax excl. £ 210.00, Untaxed Amount £ 210.00, Total £ 252.00.
